description: OPUS_5_RESPONSE_LENGTH_BLOCK is the base prompt's one documented model-specific exception, added because Opus 5's default answers run long and the effort parameter controls thinking rather than output. Response length is the most trivially measurable prompt effect there is, and it is unmeasured — agent-system-prompt.test.ts only checks the block appears for Opus 5 models and not others. The gate is on the length delta between arms, not an absolute character count, which would be meaningless across models and tasks.

tasks.description: An explain request with plenty to say — the shape that produces long answers. The checks guard quality while the gate measures brevity, so a steer that wins by degrading the answer fails.
tasks.prompt: Explain what scheduler.js does and how the retry behaviour works.
